newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - February 13.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - February 13.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had no large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The high in natural float was a bit over $950 million on Tuesday, while the low was about $350 million on Monday.
Transportation float averaged a bit under $100 million per day, with the high on Wednesday at a bit over $150 million, primarily due to fog in Charlotte, North Carolina.
